subject: Mathematics: applications and interpretation

criteria.name: Presentation
criteria.guidance: How the exploration is organised and whether it coheres.

criteria.name: Mathematical communication
criteria.guidance: Whether the notation, terminology and representation suit the mathematics.

criteria.name: Personal engagement
criteria.guidance: Evidence of engaging with the mathematics itself, not enthusiasm for the topic.

criteria.name: Reflection
criteria.guidance: Reviewing and evaluating the exploration, not describing what was done.

criteria.name: Use of mathematics
criteria.guidance: Mathematics at the right level, correct, and visibly understood.
